records.title: Delivery-fee ownership and courier compensation do not match the recorded owner-gate recommendation.
records.control_objective: Delivery-fee ownership and courier compensation do not match the recorded owner-gate recommendation.

confirmed_facts: ADR-0013 on captured main identifies the platform as merchant of record and states that the platform keeps the delivery fee to fund the carrier.
The owner-gate recommendation in PR #826 says the seller balance should not be touched by the delivery fee; the delivery journal should debit delivery-fee revenue and credit courier payable.
Unmerged PR #832 ADR-0014 and code instead describe a seller-side DELIVERY_FEE debit plus a delivery-journal PSP_CLEARING claim debit and courier payable.
PR #832 has a CodeRabbit APPROVED review on its exact head; the latest review on that head is COMMENTED.
unknowns: The owner has not recorded a subsequent decision superseding the owner-gate recommendation.
The final accounting treatment is a governance decision; this registry does not infer it.
blocking_gaps: The unmerged candidate and the recorded owner-gate recommendation prescribe materially different seller-balance and accounting traces.
The coverage verifier fails because the review evidence has no explicit processed-file declaration.
next_actions: Resolve the accounting treatment against ADR-0013 D1/D4 and the owner-gate recommendation before accepting ADR-0014.
Align seller postings, carrier payable, refund mirror and reconciliation tests to the selected treatment.
Rerun ledger, refund, idempotency and seller-statement tests after the chosen treatment is implemented.

records.title: Delivery refund-delta read/modify/write is only partially serialized.
records.control_objective: Delivery refund-delta read/modify/write is only partially serialized.

confirmed_facts: PR #831 adds pg_advisory_xact_lock before the refund path's capture replay, latest-cumulative read, delta calculation and insert.
The advisory lock is transaction-scoped and keyed by the delivery request UUID.
The candidate is two commits ahead and two commits behind captured current main.
unknowns: No completed CodeRabbit review on the exact PR head was present when captured; a fresh review request comment was posted.
The PostgreSQL isolation level was not independently proven from this candidate's code.
blocking_gaps: recognize() does not acquire the same per-delivery advisory lock before its capture/revenue reads and postings.
recognize() posts the gross completion amount and does not reconcile refunds that arrive first.
The R=G case and both event orders are not demonstrated.
The branch is behind current main and review/coverage is not green.
next_actions: Use the same per-delivery lock in refund() and recognize(), with explicit READ COMMITTED semantics.
Implement net recognition G-R and the zero-revenue/courier-payable treatment in the owner-gate recommendation.
Add both-event-order and concurrent-webhook PostgreSQL integration tests; synchronize with main and obtain exact-head review and coverage.

records.title: Account-erasure media purge batches known object keys into DeleteObjects calls of at most 1,000 keys and surfaces per-key batch errors.
records.control_objective: Account-erasure media purge batches known object keys into DeleteObjects calls of at most 1,000 keys and surfaces per-key batch errors.

confirmed_facts: The inspected S3 deletion requests include object keys but no version IDs.
AWS documents that a key-only delete in a versioning-enabled bucket inserts a delete marker and does not permanently delete prior versions.
unknowns: The actual production object-store provider, bucket versioning mode, Object Lock and retention configuration were not read.
Compatibility of the configured S3-compatible object store with version listing and version-ID deletion is not proven.
blocking_gaps: Permanent destruction of old object versions is not proven if bucket versioning is enabled or suspended.
The exact current-head CodeRabbit review is missing and the branch is two commits behind current main.
next_actions: Read actual bucket versioning and Object Lock/retention configuration through the authorized provider API.
Where versioning is enabled or suspended, enumerate versions and delete each version ID and relevant delete markers using the provider's documented API.
Add provider-compatible tests for versioned, suspended, unversioned, partial batch failure, over-1,000 keys and idempotent rerun; synchronize base and obtain exact-head review.
